audit.why: 48.15% over 27 games. Akshan's only clean windows are level 2 and level 6; Ambessa owns 3, 4-5 and everything from her first item, because Cunning Sweep (14s), Lacerate (13s) and Repudiation (18s) all outlast his 18s Heroic Swing. Chart and 7/10 difficulty hold.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase whys were boilerplate: none named a spike, a level or a cooldown, and several described Akshan winning stages the chart gives Ambessa.
audit.why: Ambessa's spikes are level 3 (dash chain complete), level 6 Public Execution (130/115/100, 1250 range, suppression) and her Eclipse/Black Cleaver item spike. Akshan's is Comeuppance at 6 (100/85/70, 2500 range).
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[1..6] around those exact spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every FULL-layer field called her kit 'Dash Chain' — an ability that does not exist. Her real abilities are Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E) and Public Execution (R). The decisive interactions were absent.
audit.why: Riot's Public Execution text: she 'blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them' — being the back of a line is what gets you picked. Drakehound's Step dashes her after any cast and grants her next attack bonus range plus an auto reset, so the cast is the tell, not the dash. Riot's Heroic Swing text says it hooks into terrain and 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain', so a melee Ambessa standing in the arc ends it.
audit.corrected: Replaced the fabricated 'Dash Chain' with the real names across tldr, winCon, enemyWin, phases, breakdown, dos, donts, loading and report; stated the farthest-target rule, the Drakehound's Step tell and the swing-collision rule.

audit.why: Lacerate 13/12/11/10/9, Repudiation 18/17/16/15/14, Cunning Sweep 14/13/12/11/10, Public Execution 130/115/100 versus Heroic Swing 18/16.5/15/13.5/12.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and report[9].
